channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks and America 250 events
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Palm Beach County residents face thousands in retroactive sewer fees from Delray Beach
item.description: Homeowners in an unincorporated Palm Beach County neighborhood are dealing with unexpected bills for years of unpaid sewer fees following a city audit. item.title: Martin County clinic sees surge in patients after federal health subsidies expire
item.description: Volunteers in Medicine in Martin County is treating more uninsured patients after enhanced Affordable Care Act subsidies ended in January, leaving more than 200,000 Floridians without coverage.

item.title: Martin County Free Clinic Has Capacity for More Patients After ACA Subsidies Expired
item.description: Volunteers in Medicine clinic in Martin County is treating more patients who lost health insurance when enhanced Affordable Care Act subsidies expired in January. The clinic says it can serve additional uninsured residents.

item.description: Florida Chief Financial Officer Blaise Ingoglia has endorsed Byron Donalds for Governor, marking another significant addition to what has become a roster of top Republican establishment figures backing the Trump-endorsed candidate.
